title: 第十五章 滨海之行第十六章 银丝
lines: 陈志远的电话三天后才打过来。
“沈老板，周总说了，陆家的事让您别掺和。港城那边水太深，不是咱们做生意的该碰的。”
沈南枝握着话筒，手指在电话线上一圈一圈地绕。
“那白若溪呢？她跟陆家有没有关系？”
电话那头沉默了一下。陈志远的声音压低了，像是不想让人听见：“周总说，白若溪这个人，上个月去过一次港城，有人看见她在陆氏大厦出现过。具体见的谁，不知道。”
“知道了。谢谢陈经理。”
“沈老板，”陈志远犹豫了一下，“周总让我带句话——您把心思放在珠宝上，明年三月的展，才是您该争的地方。”
沈南枝挂了电话，在柜台后面站了一会儿。
去港城。见过陆家的人。白若溪的动作比她想的快。
她本来以为白若溪会在京海跟她慢慢磨，一家店对一家店，一个客户对一个客户，打持久战。现在看来，白若溪的目标不是京海，是港城。京海的店只是跳板，她真正想爬上去的地方，是陆家那个圈子。
沈南枝想起原书的结局——白若溪嫁给了港城一个暴发户，过得并不幸福。但那是在沈南枝“死了”之后的故事线里。现在剧情已经变了，白若溪的走向也会变。
她不能再用原书的剧情去判断白若溪下一步的动作了。
得靠自己。
“妈，你在想什么？”珠珠的声音从脚底下传上来。
沈南枝低头一看，珠珠不知道什么时候蹲在她脚边，手里拿着那串拆了穿、穿了拆的旧珠子，仰着脸看她，眼睛圆溜溜的。
“没想什么。”
“你在发呆，”珠珠站起来，踮着脚尖，伸手摸了摸沈南枝的眉头，“眉头皱皱的，像老奶奶。”
沈南枝把她的手拨开，蹲下来跟她平视。
“珠珠，过几天妈带你去滨海市玩，好不好？”
“真的？”珠珠的眼睛一下子亮了，亮得跟通了电似的，“坐火车吗？”
“坐火车。”
“火车长什么样？比汽车大吗？比房子大吗？火车上有没有床？我可不可以睡在上面？妈我可不可以——”
“珠珠，”沈南枝按住她的肩膀，“一个一个问。”
珠珠深吸一口气，小胸脯鼓起来，然后一口气全倒出来了：“火车长什么样比汽车大吗比房子大吗火车上有没有床我可不可以睡在上面？”
沈南枝被她逗笑了，站起来，把她抱到椅子上。
“到了你就知道了。”
出发那天，沈南枝起了个大早。
她把店里的钥匙留了一把给桂姨，另一把放在了修车铺门口那块砖头底下。压砖头的时候犹豫了一下，会不会太多余了？想了想，还是压了。万一桂姨那边有什么事，总得有个人能进店。
珠珠穿了一件新裙子，白底蓝花，是桂姨前天在百货大楼买的，裙摆太大，转起圈来能飞起来。她站在店门口不停地转，转了一圈又一圈，裙摆飞得像伞，桂姨在旁边笑得合不拢嘴。
“行了行了，再转该晕了。”沈南枝拉住她。
“妈，我好看吗？”
“好看。”
“比那个白阿姨好看吗？”
沈南枝愣了一下：“谁跟你说白阿姨的？”
珠珠意识到说漏了嘴，嘴巴一抿，低下头开始抠手指头。
“珠珠。”
“桂奶奶说的……”珠珠的声音小得像蚊子叫，“桂奶奶说那个白阿姨长得好看但是心不好，说妈你长得比她好看多了，心也好。”
沈南枝看了一眼桂姨。
桂姨假装没听见，低头整理行李袋，把拉链拉上又拉开，拉开又拉上。
“姨，您跟孩子说这些干什么？”
“我说的是实话。”桂姨头都没抬，“五岁的小孩又不傻，谁好谁坏她看得出来。”
沈南枝张了张嘴，把后面的话咽回去了。背上行李，抱起珠珠，出了门。

Chen Zhiyuan's call came three days later.
"Boss Shen, Mr. Zhou told you not to get involved in the Lu family's affairs. The water in Hong Kong City is too deep and is not something we businessmen should touch."
Shen Nanzhi held the phone and wrapped his fingers around the phone line.
"What about Bai Ruoxi? Does she have anything to do with the Lu family?"
There was silence on the other end of the phone. Chen Zhiyuan's voice was lowered, as if he didn't want others to hear him: "Mr. Zhou said that Bai Ruoxi went to Hong Kong City once last month, and someone saw her in Lu's Building. I don't know who she met specifically."
"Got it. Thank you, Manager Chen."
"Boss Shen," Chen Zhiyuan hesitated, "Mr. Zhou asked me to tell you something - put your mind on jewelry. The exhibition next March is what you should compete for."
Shen Nanzhi hung up the phone and stood behind the counter for a while.
Go to Hong Kong City. I have met people from the Lu family. Bai Ruoxi moved faster than she thought.
She originally thought that Bai Ruoxi would slowly grind with her in Jinghai, fighting a protracted war from store to store, customer to customer. Now it seems that Bai Ruoxi's goal is not Jinghai, but the port city. Jinghai's store is just a springboard. The place she really wants to climb to is the Lu family circle.
Shen Nanzhi remembered the ending of the original book - Bai Ruoxi married a nouveau riche in Hong Kong City and lived an unhappy life. But that was in the storyline after Shen Nanzhi "died". Now that the plot has changed, Bai Ruoxi's direction will also change.
She can no longer use the plot of the original book to judge Bai Ruoxi's next move.
You have to rely on yourself.
"Mom, what are you thinking about?" Zhuzhu's voice came from under her feet.
Shen Nanzhi looked down and saw Zhuzhu squatting at her feet at some point, holding the string of old beads that had been taken apart and threaded, looking up at her with round eyes.
"I didn't think anything of it."
"You are in a daze," Zhuzhu stood up, stood on tiptoes, and reached out to touch Shen Nanzhi's brow, "your brows are wrinkled, like an old woman's."
Shen Nanzhi pushed her hand away and squatted down to look at her level.
"Zhuzhu, mom will take you to Binhai City to play in a few days, okay?"
"Really?" Zhuzhu's eyes suddenly lit up, as if they were electrified, "Are you taking the train?"
"Take the train."
"What does the train look like? Is it bigger than a car? Is it bigger than a house? Is there a bed on the train? Can I sleep on it? Mom, can I—"
"Zhuzhu," Shen Nanzhi held her shoulders, "Ask one by one."
Zhuzhu took a deep breath, her little chest swelled, and then she poured it all out in one breath: "What does the train look like? Is it bigger than a car? Is it bigger than a house? Is there a bed on the train and can I sleep on it?"
Shen Nanzhi was amused by her, stood up, and carried her to the chair.
"You'll know when we get there."
On the day of departure, Shen Nanzhi got up early.
She left one of the shop keys with Aunt Gui and placed the other under the brick at the door of the garage. When pressing the bricks, I hesitated. Would it be too much? After thinking about it, I still pressed it. If anything happens to Aunt Gui, there must be someone who can enter the store.
Zhuzhu was wearing a new dress, with a white background and blue flowers. Aunt Gui bought it at the department store the day before yesterday. The skirt was so big that it could fly when turned around. She stood at the door of the store and kept turning, turning around and around, her skirt flying like an umbrella, and Aunt Gui was smiling from ear to ear next to her.
"Okay, okay, I'm going to faint if I spin again." Shen Nanzhi held her back.
"Mom, do I look good?"
"Good looking."
"Do you look better than that Aunt Bai?"
Shen Nanzhi was stunned for a moment: "Who told you about Aunt Bai?"
Zhuzhu realized that she had spilled the beans, pursed her lips, lowered her head and started picking her fingers.
"Zhuzhu."
"Grandma Gui said..." Zhuzhu's voice was as low as a mosquito's cry, "Grandma Gui said that Aunt Bai is good-looking but has a bad heart. She said you are much prettier than her and have a good heart."
Shen Nanzhi glanced at Aunt Gui.
Aunt Gui pretended not to hear, lowered her head to pack the duffel bag, zippered and unzipped, unzipped and zipped.
"Auntie, why are you telling your child this?"
"I'm telling the truth." Aunt Gui didn't even raise her head. "A five-year-old child is not stupid. She can tell who is good and who is bad."
Shen Nanzhi opened his mouth and swallowed back the rest of the words. He put his luggage on his back, picked up Zhuzhu, and walked out the door.
